attchmntText: Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter & Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram International Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 14 November 2026. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion following a limited review. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, total income from operations was 20,530 lakhs. Net profit after tax was a loss of 274 lakhs. Earnings per share were negative 0.31 rupees. The company recognized stamp duty expenses of 2,082 lakhs as an exceptional item for land transfer at Kota. The business operates in the industrial fibres and related products segment. Results were published in the Financial Express and Jansatta on 15 November 2026.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 33 and 30 (4) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (LODR), the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 14th November 2026, inter alia, has approved the following: 1. Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended 30th September 2026. 2. Investment in the Rights Issue of Equity Shares of DCM Hyundai Limited.
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram International Limited Board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 14 November 2026. The Board also approved subscription to rights entitlement of 24,65,000 equity shares of associate company DCM Hyundai Limited. This investment is subject to allotment in two or more tranches. The Board authorized subscription to additional equity shares for an aggregate investment of up to INR 15 crore. The company currently holds 49.28% equity share capital in DCM Hyundai Limited. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and adopted by the Board. The meeting commenced at 12:00 Noon and concluded at 01:15 P.M. Limited Review Reports for standalone and consolidated results were issued by B S R & Co. LLP.
